A LITTLE PHILOSOPHY

Powerful agents.
Informed humans.

01 /

Put context where decisions happen.

An environment under a command. An impact preview at approval. An action map beside your work.

02 /

Keep the boundaries clear.

env-badge, blast-radius, and footprint provide visibility. They don’t allow or block commands, and their parsers have limits. A missing indicator doesn’t mean an action is safe.

03 /

Make what you learn yours.

2brain stores knowledge in Markdown and JSONL in a Git repository. Read it, inspect it, and carry it into your next session.

MAKE YOURSELF AT HOME

Small addition.
Clearer workflow.

Pick a plugin and add it to Claude Code.
Your terminal. A little more informed.

Read the marketplace guide ↗
/plugin marketplace add aqaurius6666/claude-marketplace
/plugin install env-badge@aqaurius6666

Enable function hooks with CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1 when starting Claude Code. See the plugin’s README for Desktop setup.

A few things to know.

Do I need all four plugins?

No. Each plugin has its own repository and can be installed independently. Start with the gap in your workflow that matters most.

Do these plugins prevent dangerous commands?

No. env-badge, blast-radius, and footprint are display tools, not security gates. Keep using Claude Code’s permission controls. The parsers cannot see every action inside scripts, wrappers, or other tools.

What do I need to get started?

The three display plugins use Claude Code function hooks. Enable them as described in each README. footprint and 2brain require repository access. For 2brain, follow its installer guide to set up the knowledge directory and optional maintenance jobs.
